eps.o: When the naughty cat, Lucifer, stirs up trouble for Cinderella, the Animator (Malia Baker) and princess work together with her animal friends to get to a party in time!
In this drawing tutorial parody, when the Animator (Gabe Kunda) draws Dr. Lullah from "Stugo," the mad scientist quickly gets to work causing chaos by turning a desk plant into a monster!

In this drawing tutorial parody, Gramma Alice from “Big City Greens” is not too pleased about being sketched by an Animator (Chris Houghton), and she is determined to do anything to get back to her family!
In this drawing tutorial parody, an Animator is put through a series of silly trials when everyone's favorite funny bunny, Barry, challenges the artist to his signature "BFF Test."
In this drawing tutorial parody, everyone’s favorite elves from "Prep & Landing" help the Animator get their desk decorated for Christmas just in time for a visit from Santa!
